Farm_bot.changelog:
Changes in Farm bot:
- Warns immediately if screen resolution is not 1280×720 
- Settings and farm files are saved more safely (less chance of corruption) 
- Faster and more stable emulator commands (ADB) 
- Better game loading detection and recovery 
- More reliable resource reading and teleport coordinates 
- Cleaner restart flow after freezes or stuck states

Universal.changelog:
Changes in Universal:
- Fix gold tile

Hunt.changelog:
Changes in Hunt:
- More stable with multiple emulators — fewer connection dropouts 
- Reduced CPU load 
- Screenshots are faster and less likely to freeze under PC load 
- Fixed issues where multiple windows interfered with each other 
- Better MuMu support (newer versions / Android 15) 
- Better LDPlayer detection and window matching 
- Warns immediately if screen resolution is not 1280×720 
- Settings are saved more reliably

Rally_party.changelog:

Filler.changelog:
